sync.title: Sync with myTickrs cloud
sync.toCloudText: This replaces everything in your myTickrs cloud account ({{cloud}}) with the data on this computer. It cannot be undone.
sync.fromCloudTitle: Replace the data on this computer?
sync.fromCloudText: This replaces everything on this computer with the data in your myTickrs cloud account ({{cloud}}). It cannot be undone.
sync.notAvailable: Sync is not available: the myTickrs cloud is not configured here.
sync.unset: Not set in .env: {{names}}. Sync needs CLOUD_URL and a Google or Microsoft sign-in client.
sync.intro: Copy your accounts, transactions, fee schedules, currencies, option marks and settings between this computer and your myTickrs cloud account at {{cloudUrl}}. A sync copies everything one way and replaces the other side. Sign in with the same Google or Microsoft account you use for the cloud; you then see which side changed since the last sync before anything is copied.
sync.keepCopy: To keep a copy of this computer’s data yourself, copy the database file (data/tickrs.db).
sync.privacyNote: Syncing to the cloud is optional and only for your convenience. We never sell your data or share it with third parties.
sync.signInToContinue: Sign in to your myTickrs cloud account to compare it with this computer. The sign-in opens in your browser. Nothing is copied until you choose a direction.
sync.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in with {{provider}} in your browser…
sync.expired: The sign-in took too long, so nothing was synced. Try again.
sync.comparing: Signed in as {{email}}. Comparing this computer with the cloud…
sync.cloudEmpty: No data in the cloud yet.
sync.confirmExpired: No direction was chosen in time, so nothing was synced. Check again.

state.inSync: Both sides match the last sync on {{date}}. Nothing to do.
state.localChanged: This computer has changes the cloud doesn’t.
state.cloudChanged: The cloud has changes this computer doesn’t.
state.bothChanged: Both sides changed since {{date}}. Syncing in either direction discards the other side’s changes.
state.firstSync: First sync with this account. Check which side has the data you want to keep.

markets.title: Markets
markets.intro: A listing's market decides its trading hours, holidays, currency and which data providers price it. The suffix tells markets apart: SHOP.TO is Canadian, and a ticker without a suffix (AAPL) is in the home market. The United States and Canada are ready-made; add others from the list of markets.
markets.removeNote: A market can be removed only when none of your symbols are in it. The market for tickers without a suffix always stays.
markets.marketHint: Fills in the code, name, currency, hours, suffixes and holidays. You can change any of them.
markets.name: Name
markets.currencyHint: Listings in this market trade in it.
markets.addSession: Add a session (for a lunch break)
markets.closedDaysHint: Trading days the market is closed, e.g. 2026-10-01. It trades on the days ticked above except these.
markets.suffixHint: The suffix after the dot in a symbol (TO in SHOP.TO) and the exchange it stands for. A new ticker added in this market gets the first suffix.
markets.testSymbolHint: A symbol that always has a price, used to check a provider's API key.

import.title: Import
import.intro: Set up a new account's holdings from screenshots of your broker's positions, or from CSV, JSON and XML files. After that, add transactions as they happen.

steps.uploadLocked: Sign in first (step 1), then upload your files here.
steps.reviewEmpty: The holdings read from your files appear here, to check and correct before anything is saved.
steps.saveEmpty: Once the holdings look right, save them to the account.

import.noCurrencyAccount: You had no {{currency}} account, so "{{name}}" was created for you. Edit it or add your own.
import.drop: Drop files here, or click to choose them
import.dropHint: A screenshot of your positions, or a CSV, JSON or XML (OFX, QFX) file — one at a time
import.notImportable: {{name}}: only screenshots, CSV, JSON and XML files can be imported.
import.aiUnavailable: Reading screenshots needs myTickrs cloud. CSV, JSON and XML files work without it.
import.aiSignIn: Sign in to myTickrs cloud to import your files. Screenshots are read through the cloud.
import.waitingForSignIn: Finish signing in in your browser…
import.aiUsageUnlimited: AI files used: {{used}} (no limit in development)
import.aiNotSaved: Uploaded files are not saved in myTickrs cloud; they are only passed to the AI model to extract the data.
import.aiNoticeBody: Screenshots are read by {{processor}}, through myTickrs cloud. The whole image is sent, with any names or account numbers on it. myTickrs does not keep it, and the AI is told not to return personal details.
import.aiNoticeStructured: For CSV, JSON and XML files, only the column names and the first 20 rows are sent, and only when the columns are not recognised. The whole file is sent only if you ask the AI to read it.
import.aiNeeded: {{name}}: sign in to myTickrs cloud to read screenshots.
import.mappingIntro: Say which column holds each value of a holding. These columns are remembered for the next file laid out the same way.
import.mappingFromAi: Proposed by the AI from the first rows.
import.readWithAiNeeded: These columns do not give each holding its ticker and quantity. The AI can read the rows themselves instead; the whole file is sent.
import.readWithAiIntro: If a value is inside a description rather than in a column of its own, the AI can read the rows themselves instead; the whole file is sent.
import.readWithAiCost: It counts as one AI file: {{left}} of {{limit}} left.
import.readWithAiCostUnlimited: It counts as one AI file.
import.readWithAiTooLong: The AI reads files of up to {{max}} rows; split this one into parts first.
import.reviewIntro: Tick the holdings to import. Rows that need a look start unticked.
import.openingIntro: Each holding is saved as one opening trade on this date, with its realized P/L. Add later transactions as they happen.
